notes.title: Demo Update - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
2025/09/18 Update

Fixed an issue where Ranches would sometimes not occupy surrounding farmland.



2025/09/16 Update

Fixed a bug where buildings duplicated when moved.


[hr][/hr]


The demo has been updated. This update includes bug fixes and several UI improvements.

Thank you for all your reports and feedback.


Changes
Added a button to display shortcut keys and a new shortcut key to rotate directional cards.

Fixed an issue with translations.

Fixed a bug where a building would survive if the castle was destroyed while the building was being moved.

Fixed a bug where Monks were counted in the soldier count of the "Ironworks" (the developer's intention is for Monks not to be considered soldiers).

Fixed a bug where Ironworks income would decrease when a Soldier activated the "Jump ramp" or "Dash Sign".

Fixed an issue where the destruction effect would display when a battering ram from a siege weapon hit a moving building, but the building would not be destroyed.

Enabled clicking the terms section to close the card details view.

Adjusted the enemy's thinking logic.


Known Issues Under Investigation
A phenomenon where buildings duplicate themselves when moved.

A phenomenon where card selection becomes impossible.


Planned for the Next Update
Card balance adjustments.

Changes to the specifications of the decks used by enemies.

Currently, the decks used by enemies are the ones that the opposing player had at the time of winning a round with that number of stars. We have received feedback that this method feels unfair, as it means the enemy is using a slightly more advanced build than the player. We plan to change these specifications to make the game feel more fair.

notes.title: Demo Update - Bug Fixes and Minor Card Adjustments
notes.content:
We've just released an update for the demo version. 

The main goal of this update is to fix bugs that have been reported, but we've also made some minor balance adjustments.


Bug Fixes


We've addressed the following issues based on your reports. We're still investigating other bugs.

Fixed a bug where the Monk could activate buildings 3 times instead of the correct 2 times.

Fixed incorrect translation data for the Silo.

Fixed an issue where time would sometimes remain frozen in certain cases.

We've adjusted the movement logic, as it wasn't behaving as expected. Units will now more aggressively advance into enemy territory, which might slightly impact card strength.


Card Adjustments


This update isn't primarily for card adjustments, so we've avoided major changes and limited modifications to just one card.

The cost of the Lumberjack Hut has been changed from 200 to 100. The Lumberjack Hut had low income, making it difficult to turn a profit. This change should reduce instances where building it results in a loss.

notes.title: Demo Update - Game-breaking Bug Fix Completed
notes.content:
Some players in certain regions were experiencing issues such as being unable to start the game or having villagers fly off beyond the sea. This problem had been present since the demo's release.

We've finally resolved this issue. 

We believe that players who were previously unable to play will now be able to with this update.



Our sincere thanks go out to everyone who helped us on Discord.

notes.title: Demo Update - Fix for Unplayable Bug
notes.content:
We've investigated the unplayable bug that multiple users reported and have now fixed the issue. This should resolve the problem for many players.

However, issues might still occur depending on your playing environment. We'll continue to work on improving stability.

We sincerely thank all players for their reports.


2025/6/20 Update
It seems that the problem is still occurring. We are unable to reproduce the situation and are having difficulty investigating. We apologize for the inconvenience, but we are continuing our investigation.


2025/6/22 Update
We've identified and fixed the issue. Our sincere thanks to everyone who helped us on Discord. Thank you very much.

notes.title: Demo Update - UI Improvements and Balance Adjustments
notes.content:
We've updated the demo!


UI Improvements
Responding to feedback that drag-and-drop was prone to misoperation, you can now play cards by clicking a card and then clicking its destination. Along with this change, zooming in on cards in your hand during a round is now exclusively done by right-clicking. Additionally, buildings with directional placement now have a dedicated rotation button.


Balance Updates
Significant balance adjustments have been made, primarily concerning soldiers (equipment). The main updates are as follows:


Adjustments for Soldiers
Villagers equipped with swords or bows now become soldiers. Soldiers have high attack power but cannot activate many buildings. This encourages players to more clearly distinguish between internal affairs (economy/development) and attack strategies.


Dojo
Instead of equipping bows on activation, bowmen now appear when the Dojo is played.


Siege Stronghold (Siege Lab)
Its effect has been changed; siege engineers now appear when the building is played. Siege engineers aren't particularly strong soldiers, but they have a 10% chance to destroy an opponent's building. Along with this change, the name has been updated.


Barracks (New Card)
Barracks have been added in place of the Ironworks. Barracks produce swordsmen.


Workshop
This building was rarely used, so it has been reworked. Soldiers who clear forests now become siege engineers.


Pirate Ship (New Card)
Produces swordsmen based on the number of surrounding sea tiles. This will be a powerful option for map-focused builds.


Militia barracks
Its effect has been changed to align more with its name's image, as its previous effect was too strong. The effect where all buildings become towers has been removed. Instead, bowmen now appear equal to the number of buildings you have. As they are bowmen, synergies related to projectiles should still be usable.


Future Plans for the Demo
This demo will be temporarily delisted at the end of June. It may be released again in the future to coincide with events.

notes.title: Demo Update - Design Changes and Minor Balance Adjustments
notes.content:
The title screen design has been updated. Sorata Sanjou's wonderful illustrations enrich the world of "One King Is Enough." Additionally, we've adjusted several cards that were found to be currently too strong.

Lumberjack's Cabin and Pioneer's Lumberjack's Cabin: Income changed from 7 to 5.

Fortune Teller's Hut and Casino: Income reduced.

However, a larger balance adjustment is planned for the future, and the current adjustments are a trial run until then.


Future Plans for the Demo Version
This demo version is expected to remain available at least until the end of June, and possibly a little longer. During this period, at least one major adjustment reflecting your feedback will be implemented.

notes.title: Demo Version Update - Bug Fixes, Combo Display, and More
notes.content:
We've updated the demo version.


When selecting cards, cards that have synergy with others in your deck will now display a "COMBO!" mark. Hover your mouse cursor over the "COMBO!" mark to see the names of the synergistic cards.
We've adjusted matchmaking so that players at the Stone rank will no longer be matched with human players.
Fixed a bug that caused the in-game map to become unoperable after certain actions.
Fixed several other bugs.
Made minor adjustments to improve playability.
